name: adidas Yeezy Foam Runner 'Carbon'
story_html: The adidas Yeezy Foam Runner ‘Carbon’ brings a stealthy one-note finish to the futuristic slip-on. A dark shade of grey is applied to the one-piece build, made with injected EVA foam and featuring flowing lines and a sculpted heel designed to cradle the back of the foot. Strategically mapped vents throughout the vamp and side panels provide enhanced breathability, while the textured footbed offers a comfortable fit. Underpinning the clog-like silhouette is a durable rubber outsole.
